subject: ACME pilot: discovery recap, MAP & legal redlines
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: ACME pilot — discovery follow-up & MAP

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we all have alignment: 

- Objective: 4-week pilot to validate latency and cost savings on your search-rewrite pipeline.
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 220ms, per-token cost reduction >= 35% vs current setup, and no PII leakage on sample prompts.
- Proposed timeline: pilot kickoff week of Mar 8, 2-week ramp + 2-week measurement.

Next steps / owners: 
1) I’ll send a mutual action plan (attached) with milestones and deliverables — Marissa (done).
2) ACME to confirm data access & basic compliance needs (Sarah) — by EOD Fri.
3) Legal/procurement intro if the pilot and commercial discussions move forward (Tom) — TBD.

I attached the draft MAP and a short runbook. Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20260225-ACME-MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan, milestones)

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME pilot — discovery follow-up & MAP

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good. I’m looping in Tom (procurement) and our legal alias so they have visibility. A couple quick items for us:

- We need a summary of your data retention and deletion processes for the pilot.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can sign our standard DPA or if we should expect a redline?

I’ll aim to confirm data access by EOD Friday. If procurement/legal want to set a short call, reply-all with availability.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Li | Senior Product Manager, Search
ACME Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: ACME — draft redlines & DPA (for legal review)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Per the note below, attaching the redlines we expect from Redwood for the pilot (PDF). Key callouts:
- Pilot scope limited to the agreed dataset and a single Redwood shared model; no production access.
- Retention: default retention for pilot logs is 30 days; we can configure shorter retention for sensitive flows.
- Liability: we’ve offered mutual indemnities and a scaled cap for pilot.

Jonas (cc) is our internal contracts lead — he can coordinate any legal-level questions. 

Would you be able to share whether counsel needs any further artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 report, DPA language) to triage the redlines? Happy to share our SOC 2 report and a short security one-pager.

Thanks,
Marissa
Attachments: 20260303-ACME-Redlines.pdf (contract redlines, DPA notes)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: bump — status on redlines / counsel review

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Just checking in on the redlines I sent last week. Any update from counsel or procurement on timing? We’re holding the proposed kickoff slot the week of Mar 8 but can be flexible if you need more time.

If it helps, I can:
- Share our SOC 2 type II report and a focused security Q&A (1-pager)
- Have Jonas join a quick legal sync to review redlines line-by-line

Appreciate any timing update so we can adjust resourcing on our side.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, ACME Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T16:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: bump — status on redlines / counsel review

Hi Marissa —

Apologies for the delay and thanks for the nudge. Quick status: procurement deprioritized pilots this week while we close a separate vendor evaluation (surprise timing). I’ve passed your redlines to counsel but they asked for two items to triage faster:

1) SOC 2 type II report (latest) and an excerpt on encryption at rest/in transit.
2) Confirmation of whether Redwood will sign our standard DPA or expects changes — a short summary from you would help counsel decide whether to redline or accept.

If you can provide those two artifacts today/early tomorrow, I’ll push counsel to review and get back to you with edits or a call request. If procurement remains out next week we may need to push the kickoff ~1 week.

Appreciate it —
Sarah
